title: Bas Itna Sa Khwaab Hai
desc: An Ambitious Small-Town Man Gets An Opportunity To Work At The News Channel Of His Idol, A Media Tycoon. He Becomes A Clever Businessman And Has Everything He Ever Dreamt Of, But At A Price.

title: Cheeni Kum
desc: A hard-edged London chef believes he's found true love, only to learn that his potential partner's father is surprisingly younger than him, complicating their romance

title: Qarib Qarib Singlle
desc: Two Contrasting Personalities Yogi And Jaya Meet Through A Dating App And Rediscover Themselves While They Set Out To Revisit Their Past.

title: Runway 34
desc: Upon dealing with the rough climate in Cochin, two pilots make a risky landing in Thiruvananthapuram. But trouble ensues when personnel from the AAIB probes the matter.

title: Talaash : The Answer Lies Within
desc: A police officer investigates a mysterious death in Mumbai, facing personal struggles and a broken marriage. A sex worker adds to the puzzle as he seeks the truth.

title: Murder Mubarak
desc: A maverick cop dives into a murder case, spotlighting a web of suspects. As he infiltrates their world, hidden truths unravel-revealing a mystery far deeper than expected.

title: Happy Bhag Jayegi
desc: Happy runs from her wedding to marry Guddu but ends up at a Pakistani politician's home, triggering chaos, comedy, and a mess only she could cause.

title: Aatma - Feel It Around You
desc: After Losing The Custody Of His Daughter Nia To His Wife, Maya, Abhay Dies In A Car Accident. However, His Spirit Continues To Haunt Their Happy And Peaceful Life.

title: Gul Makai
desc: Malala Yousafzai is targeted by the Taliban after the Sharia law is imposed in the Swat valley which prohibits girls from going to school. A defiant Malala refuses to stay silent.

title: Paltan
desc: Lieutenant Colonel Raj Singh Yadav and his soldiers protect the Nathu La Pass from the Chinese while coping with the pain of being separated from their loved ones.

title: Rang Rasiya
desc: A young and talented Raja Ravi Varma trains under the king of Kerala. He moves to British-era Bombay and meets Sugandha, who initially discredits his artwork but later becomes his muse.

title: Saaya
desc: Akash and Maya, two doctors, are happily married and expecting a baby. However, things take a turn when Maya's bus crashes and she is believed to be dead.

title: Cabaret
desc: Sally is a cabaret dancer at the Kit Kat Klub and falls in love with 2 men who are regulars at the club. Their lives get entwined with the Nazi Party.

title: Holiday
desc: While holidaying in Goa with her family, a shy Muskaan falls for Dino, a dancer at the resort. Problems ensue when her father objects to their relationship as he believes Dino has impregnated a woman.

title: Kahaani 2
desc: Vidya races to save Minnie from kidnappers but lands in the hospital after an accident. Time runs out as she fights to survive and protect the child.

title: Tumbbad
desc: In a mythological tale, a goddess faces unforeseen consequences when humans construct a temple for her firstborn. The story explores how their actions impact both the divine and mortal realms.

title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
desc: In Bareilly, free-spirited Bitti embraces life on her own terms until she meets Chirag and Pritam, sparking unexpected changes in her journey.

title: Gangubai Kathiawadi
desc: The journey of a brothel worker's rise to power, as she fights for women's rights and earns public respect, defying patriarchy with strength and dignity.

title: Attack
desc: After a terror attack leaves him paralysed, Arjun grieves for his lost love. When the attacker returns, he risks everything in a dangerous experiment for revenge.

title: Blank
desc: A Doctor Contacts The Chief Of An Anti-Terrorism Squad When He Discovers A Timed Bomb Fixed To The Body Of An Accident Victim Who Has Amnesia.

title: Daddy
desc: A street thug rises to feared don and later a political figure, as his complex life unfolds amid crime, loyalty, transformation, and public identity.

title: Kuch Kuch Locha Hai
desc: Praveen Patel, A 45-Year-Old Married Businessman, Is Approached By Shanaya, An Actress, Who Wants To Move In With Him To Prepare For A Role. He Then Pretends To Be Single To Impress Her.

title: Jayantabhai Ki Luv Story
desc: When Simran, A Young Woman, Struggles To Settle In Mumbai And Lands Into A Hostile Neighbourhood, Jayantabhai, A Small-Time Gangster, Helps And Falls In Love With Her, Unaware That She Is His Rival.
